summary.goal: Manage isolated git worktree workspaces for each task. Each task gets its own directory with a unique branch, enabling parallel execution on the same repository.

acceptance_criteria.description: createWorkspace(taskId, repoUrl, baseBranch, taskContext) creates worktree at /forge-workspaces/run-X-task-Y/repo
Branch name pattern: forge/run-{runId}-task-{taskId}
Write .forge/context.json with task description, criteria, expected artifacts
Write .forge/mcp-config.json with Forge MCP server connection and task_id
cleanupWorkspace(taskId) removes worktree and branch
Configurable retention: keep workspaces for N hours after completion for debugging
Workspace creation failures throw WorkspaceError with specific type (disk_full, clone_failed, worktree_failed, permission_denied) - task transitions to 'failed' state with error details

observations: Git worktrees share .git directory - lightweight isolation
Branch-per-task enables clean PRs and parallel work
Context file provides agent with all task info without relay round-trip
MCP config connects agent to Forgemaster for reporting
patterns: Workspace base directory configurable via env var
Async git operations with proper error handling

steps.title: Create WorkspaceManager interface
steps.description: Define interface for workspace lifecycle operations

acceptance_criteria.description: WorkspaceManager interface: createWorkspace(config), cleanupWorkspace(taskId), getWorkspacePath(taskId), scheduleCleanup(taskId, retentionHours)
WorkspaceConfig type: { taskId, runId, repoUrl, baseBranch, taskContext: { step_id, title, description, acceptance_criteria[], artifacts_expected? } }
WorkspaceResult type: { path, branchName, contextFile, mcpConfigFile }

steps.title: Implement git worktree operations
steps.description: Low-level git worktree add/remove commands via child_process

acceptance_criteria.description: gitWorktreeAdd(repoPath, worktreePath, branchName, baseBranch) creates worktree
gitWorktreeRemove(repoPath, worktreePath) removes worktree and optionally branch
gitClone(repoUrl, targetPath) clones if repo not cached locally
All operations are async and throw GitOperationError with stderr message on failure

architecture.error_handling: Capture stderr, throw GitOperationError with full context including command and stderr

acceptance_criteria.description: createWorkspace creates /forge-workspaces/run-{runId}-task-{taskId}/repo directory
Branch name pattern: forge/run-{runId}-task-{taskId}
Writes .forge/context.json with task description, acceptance criteria
Writes .forge/mcp-config.json with Forge MCP server URL and X-Task-ID header
cleanupWorkspace removes worktree and optionally deletes branch

architecture.context_file_format: { task_id, run_id, step_id, title, description, acceptance_criteria: [{ id, description }] }

steps.title: Implement workspace retention policy
steps.description: Keep completed workspaces for configurable period for debugging

acceptance_criteria.description: scheduleCleanup(taskId, retentionHours) records cleanup timestamp via ForgeStorage
cleanupExpiredWorkspaces() queries ForgeStorage.getExpiredCleanups() and removes workspaces
Configurable default retention (env var FORGE_WORKSPACE_RETENTION_HOURS, default 24)
Scheduled cleanup job runs periodically (every hour)

architecture.storage: Uses workspace_cleanup table defined in forge-storage fs-s2

steps.title: Implement workspace creation error handling
steps.description: Explicit error types and failure handling for workspace creation

acceptance_criteria.description: WorkspaceError class extends Error with type: 'disk_full' | 'clone_failed' | 'worktree_failed' | 'permission_denied'
Check disk space before creating workspace (configurable threshold, default 1GB)
Retry clone with exponential backoff (up to 3 attempts) - throw after retries exhausted
Cleanup partial workspace on failure (remove any created directories)
WorkspaceError includes actionable message: 'Workspace creation failed: {type}. {suggestion}'
Caller (task queue) catches WorkspaceError and transitions task to 'failed' state with error.message

error_types.disk_full: Disk space below threshold ({available}MB < {required}MB). Free up space or increase FORGE_WORKSPACE_DISK_THRESHOLD.
error_types.clone_failed: Failed to clone {repoUrl} after 3 attempts. Check network and repository access.
error_types.worktree_failed: Failed to create worktree: {stderr}. Check git version and repository state.
error_types.permission_denied: Permission denied writing to {path}. Check FORGE_WORKSPACE_BASE permissions.

architecture.no_silent_fallback: All failures throw - no 'return null' or 'skip workspace' patterns
